argument: Three independent lines converge: technician confirms trend structure with both moving averages aligned, estimate_scribe shows genuine upward revision momentum with a four-quarter beat streak, and fundamentalist shows the valuation premium is backed by 56% revenue growth, not narrative. oracle_options prices a real expected move without a strong directional lean either way, which is consistent with an upside case rather than contradicting it. The abstentions (insider_reader, senate_watcher, macro_sage) are not bearish signals -- they are seats correctly declining to manufacture an opinion from thin data, which is exactly the behaviour this council rewards.
